--- schema ---
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id                 String     @id @default(cuid())
  email              String     @unique
  passwordHash       String
  name               String?
  businessDescription String    @default("")
  timezone           String     @default("UTC")
  outreachPaused     Boolean    @default(false)
  createdAt          DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime   @updatedAt

  leads        Lead[]
  sessions     Session[]
  providers    Provider[]
  suppressions Suppression[]
  activities   Activity[]
  templates    EmailTemplate[]
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  tokenHash String   @unique
  userId    String
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model Lead {
  id                   String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId               String
  name                 String
  companyOrChannel     String   @default("")
  email                String?
  websiteUrl           String?
  youtubeUrl           String?
  instagramUrl         String?
  telegramUrl          String?
  niche                String?
  followersCount       Int?
  contentActivity      Int      @default(0)
  longFormCount        Int      @default(0)
  shortFormCount       Int      @default(0)
  growthSignal         Int      @default(0)
  commercialPotential  Int      @default(0)
  leadScore            Int      @default(0)
  scoreBreakdown       String   @default("{}")
  insight              String?
  status               String   @default("New")
  lastContactAt        DateTime?
  nextFollowUpAt       DateTime?
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  user      User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emails    EmailMessage[]
  followUps FollowUp[]
  replies   Reply[]
  activities Activity[]

  @@unique([userId, email])
  @@index([userId, status])
}

model Provider {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  kind            String
  configEncrypted String
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  dailyLimit      Int      @default(25)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, kind, isActive])
}

model EmailMessage {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId              String
  leadId              String
  subject             String
  body                String
  status              String    @default("Draft")
  approvalHash        String?
  approvalExpiresAt   DateTime?
  providerMessageId   String?
  errorMessage        String?
  sentAt              DateTime?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())

  lead    Lead    @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  replies Reply[]

  @@index([userId, status])
}

model FollowUp {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  leadId    String
  dueDate   DateTime
  status    String   @default("Pending")
  note      String   @default("")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  lead Lead @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, dueDate, status])
}

model Reply {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  leadId          String
  emailMessageId  String?
  classification  String
  contentSnippet  String
  receivedAt      DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  lead        Lead          @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emailMessage EmailMessage? @relation(fields: [emailMessageId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
}

model Suppression {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  email     String
  reason    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, email])
}

model Activity {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  leadId    String?
  type      String
  payload   String   @default("{}")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lead Lead? @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model EmailTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  name      String
  category  String   @default("Custom")
  subject   String
  body      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, category])
}

  email                String?
  websiteUrl           String?
  youtubeUrl           String?
  instagramUrl         String?
  telegramUrl          String?
  niche                String?
  followersCount       Int?
  contentActivity      Int      @default(0)
  longFormCount        Int      @default(0)
  shortFormCount       Int      @default(0)
  growthSignal         Int      @default(0)
  commercialPotential  Int      @default(0)
  leadScore            Int      @default(0)
  scoreBreakdown       String   @default("{}")
  insight              String?
  status               String   @default("New")
  lastContactAt        DateTime?
  nextFollowUpAt       DateTime?
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  user      User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emails    EmailMessage[]
  followUps FollowUp[]
  replies   Reply[]
  activities Activity[]

  @@unique([userId, email])
  @@index([userId, status])
}

model Provider {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  kind            String
  configEncrypted String
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  dailyLimit      Int      @default(25)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, kind, isActive])
}

model EmailMessage {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId              String
  leadId              String
  subject             String
  body                String
  status              String    @default("Draft")
  approvalHash        String?
  approvalExpiresAt   DateTime?
  providerMessageId   String?
  errorMessage        String?
  sentAt              DateTime?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())

  lead    Lead    @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  replies Reply[]

  @@index([userId, status])
}

model FollowUp {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  leadId    String
  dueDate   DateTime
  status    String   @default("Pending")
  note      String   @default("")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  lead Lead @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, dueDate, status])
}

model Reply {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  leadId          String
  emailMessageId  String?
  classification  String
  contentSnippet  String
  receivedAt      DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  lead        Lead          @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emailMessage EmailMessage? @relation(fields: [emailMessageId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
}

model Suppression {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  email     String
  reason    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, email])
}

model Activity {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  leadId    String?
  type      String
  payload   String   @default("{}")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lead Lead? @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model EmailTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  name      String
  category  String   @default("Custom")
  subject   String
  body      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, category])
}
